info.title: ForgeAI - Api Gateway
info.description:
API Gateway single public entry point providing authentication, resilience, and metrics.

*Part of the ForgeAI Local AI Software Engineering Platform.*

get.description: Returns current microservice status, version, and health metrics.

post.description: Registers a local source code directory as a project workspace for intelligence and indexing.

400.description: Invalid directory path or project settings

get.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific project workspace ID.

delete.description: Deletes a project workspace registration and clears its vector index.

get.description: Returns available drives, current path, parent, and subdirectories for folder navigation.
Returns all registered repository metadata records for the authenticated user.

post.description: Registers and inspects a local repository directory.
Clones a remote repository URL locally.
Parses AST symbols and generates Qdrant embeddings for code search.

get.description: Returns the filtered source code directory file tree hierarchy.
Retrieves current parsing and indexing progress.
Reads content of a file within the repository by its relative path.

post.description: Writes text content to a target file.

get.description: Returns available drives, current path, parent, and subdirectories for folder navigation.

post.description: Initiates an asynchronous agent task workflow (ASK, PLAN, CODE, DEBUG, TEST, REVIEW, EXPLAIN).

get.description: Retrieves active execution status and step history of an agent run.

post.description: Resumes a paused agent run after human review or approval.
Cancels an active agent run task execution.

get.description: Returns detailed breakdown of all tool, planning, and execution steps for a run.
Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint streaming real-time agent events (agent.started, plan.created, tool.started, test.passed, etc.).
Returns available Ollama coding models installed on the system.

post.description: Switches active LLM coding model (e.g., FAST 3B vs QUALITY 7B).

400.description: Model ID not installed or invalid

get.summary: Get LLM Service & Ollama Connectivity Status
get.description: Checks connection status to Ollama host and currently loaded models.
Returns latency, throughput, RAM, VRAM, and JSON reliability benchmarks for evaluated local coding models.
Returns current branch, staged, modified, and untracked files.
Returns unified git diff text for working tree modifications.

post.description: Creates a new local git branch in workspace.
Checks out specified target branch or commit SHA.
Stages and commits working tree modifications.
Reverts modified/deleted files back to HEAD commit state.
Stages specified files into the Git index (git add).
Unstages specified files from the Git index (git restore --staged).
Performs regex/text query search across workspace repository files.
Performs dense vector similarity search in Qdrant collection.
Finds class, function, or method definitions by symbol identifier.

get.description: Exposes Gateway performance, error rates, and connection metrics in Prometheus text format.
